passages.title: 幫鳥巢撐傘的阿伯
passages.text: Near our school, there is a small park with an old tree. This spring, a pair of birds built a nest in it, and soon there were four tiny eggs inside. Mr. Lin, an old man who walks in the park every day, often {1} up at the nest and smiled. One afternoon, dark clouds came, and it began to rain hard. Mr. Lin was worried. He wanted to {2} the eggs from the heavy rain. So he {3} home and came back with a big umbrella. He climbed a short ladder and tied the umbrella to a branch above the nest. People walking by laughed at him, but he didn't {4}. Two weeks later, the eggs hatched. Every morning, the mother bird {5} food to her babies, and Mr. Lin watched them from his bench. "They're my little neighbors," he told us proudly.

blanks.why: look up at「抬頭看」，阿伯常抬頭看鳥巢。heard（聽到）、said（說）、told（告訴）都不能和 up at 連用表示「抬頭看」。
protect A from B「保護 A 免於 B」，保護鳥蛋不被大雨淋。decide（決定）、agree（同意）、hope（希望）都沒有 ___ A from B 的用法。
ran home「跑回家」，拿了傘再回來。said、knew、thought 都不是移動的動作，不能接 home 表示「回家」。
didn't mind「不介意」，被笑也不在乎。borrow（借）、spell（拼字）、marry（嫁娶）單獨放在 didn't 後面都說不通。
bring A to B「帶 A 給 B」，鳥媽媽帶食物給寶寶。spent（花費）、cost（值…錢）、paid（付錢）都不能表示「帶來食物」。

passages.zh: 我們學校附近有一座小公園，裡面有一棵老樹。今年春天，一對鳥在樹上築了巢，不久巢裡就有了四顆小小的蛋。林伯伯是一位每天都在公園散步的老人，他常抬頭看著鳥巢微笑。一天下午，烏雲飄來，開始下起大雨。林伯伯很擔心，他想保護那些蛋不被大雨淋到。於是他跑回家，拿了一把大傘回來。他爬上一個矮梯子，把傘綁在鳥巢上方的樹枝上。路過的人都笑他，但他不介意。兩個星期後，蛋孵化了。每天早上，鳥媽媽都帶食物來給寶寶吃，林伯伯就坐在長椅上看著牠們。「牠們是我的小鄰居，」他驕傲地對我們說。

passages.title: 借來的那把雨傘
passages.text: Last week, it rained suddenly after school. I didn't {1} an umbrella, so I just stood at the school gate. A girl from another class, Amy, said, "Let's share mine." She walked me all the way to the bus stop. The next day, she lent me her extra umbrella. "Keep it until next week," she said. But I kept forgetting to {2} it. Every day, I left it at home. Then one rainy morning, I saw Amy {3} to class in the rain without an umbrella. I felt terrible. That night, I put the umbrella next to my shoes so I couldn't forget it. The next morning, I gave it back to her with a thank-you card and said sorry again and again. "It doesn't {4}," she said with a smile. "I'm just happy you like it." Now we are good friends, and we {5} the same bus home every day.

blanks.why: bring an umbrella「帶傘」，沒帶傘所以只能站在校門口。spend（花費）、cost（值…錢）、pay（付錢）都不能接 an umbrella 表示「帶著」。
return it「歸還它」，一直忘了還傘。agree（同意）、arrive（抵達）、happen（發生）都是不及物動詞，後面不能直接接受詞 it。
see + 人 + V-ing「看到某人正在…」，看到 Amy 淋雨跑去上課。reading、sleeping、sitting 都不能接 to class 表示「前往教室」。
It doesn't matter.「沒關係」，Amy 表示不在意。mind、agree、hope 都不能用 It 當主詞說「沒關係」。
take the bus「搭公車」。spend（花費）、cost（值…錢）、pay（付錢）都不能接 the bus 表示「搭乘」。

passages.zh: 上星期，放學後突然下起雨。我沒帶傘，只好站在校門口。另一班的女生 Amy 說：「我們一起撐我的吧。」她一路陪我走到公車站。隔天，她把她多的一把傘借給我。「下星期再還就好，」她說。可是我一直忘了還，每天都把傘留在家裡。後來一個下雨的早上，我看到 Amy 沒撐傘，淋著雨跑去上課，我覺得很過意不去。那天晚上，我把傘放在鞋子旁邊，這樣就不會忘記了。隔天早上，我把傘還給她，附上一張感謝卡，還一直跟她道歉。「沒關係啦，」她笑著說，「你喜歡這把傘我就很開心了。」現在我們成了好朋友，每天一起搭同一班公車回家。

passages.title: 電梯卡住的十分鐘
passages.text: Last Sunday, my little brother and I got into the elevator in our building. Suddenly, it {1} between the fifth and sixth floors. The lights went off for a second, and my brother began to cry. "Don't worry," I said. I tried to look calm, but my heart was beating fast. There was a phone in the elevator, so I {2} it to call the guard. "Stay there. We'll get you out in ten minutes," he said. To help my brother {3} crying, I told him a funny story about our cat. Soon he was laughing. Ten minutes later, the elevator moved again, and the door opened. Mom was waiting there with a worried {4} on her face. My brother ran to her and shouted, "Mom, we had an adventure!" But since that day, he always wants to {5} the stairs.

blanks.why: it stopped「電梯停住了」，卡在五樓和六樓之間。wrote（寫）、ate（吃）、learned（學）都不能用電梯當主詞。
used it to call「用它打電話」。ate（吃）、drank（喝）、wore（穿戴）都不能拿電話來打給警衛。
stop + V-ing「停止做…」，讓弟弟不要再哭。hope、decide、want 後面要接 to V，不能接 crying。
a worried look「擔心的表情」，look 在這裡是名詞。matter（事情）、fault（過錯）、brand（品牌）都不能「在臉上」表示表情。
take the stairs「走樓梯」，弟弟從此不敢搭電梯。spend（花費）、cost（值…錢）、pay（付錢）都不能接 the stairs。

passages.zh: 上星期天，我和弟弟走進我們大樓的電梯。突然，電梯停在五樓和六樓之間。燈熄了一下，弟弟開始哭。「別擔心，」我說。我努力裝得很冷靜，但心跳得好快。電梯裡有一支電話，我就用它打給警衛。「待在裡面，我們十分鐘內就把你們救出來，」他說。為了讓弟弟不要再哭，我跟他講了一個我們家貓咪的好笑故事，不久他就笑了。十分鐘後，電梯又動了，門打開了。媽媽在外面等著，臉上一副擔心的表情。弟弟跑向她大喊：「媽，我們剛剛去冒險了！」不過從那天起，他總是要走樓梯。

passages.title: 爸爸送來的便當
passages.text: Every morning, Mom makes lunch for me. But yesterday I woke up late and forgot to {1} my lunch box with me. At noon, everyone opened their lunch boxes, and I had nothing to eat. My stomach was so {2} that my classmates laughed. Then I saw Dad at the classroom door. He had {3} all the way from his office with my lunch box in his hand. His face was red, and he was breathing hard. "You {4} hungry," he joked. I felt bad because his office is far from my school. I said sorry, but he just smiled. "No problem. Just remember to {5} your lunch box by the door tonight." That afternoon, my rice tasted better than ever. When I got home, I made Dad a cup of coffee to say thank you.

blanks.why: take A with me「把 A 隨身帶著」，忘了帶便當出門。wake（叫醒）、fall（落下）、lie（躺）都不能接 my lunch box with me。
so noisy that…「肚子叫得很大聲，同學都笑了」。crowded（擁擠的）、honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容肚子餓的聲音。
had run「一路跑來」，had 後面接過去分詞 run。said、known、thought 都不是移動的動作，不能接 all the way from his office。
look + 形容詞「看起來…」。hear、listen、watch 後面都不能直接接形容詞 hungry 來形容人。
put A by the door「把 A 放在門邊」。eat（吃）、drink（喝）、spell（拼字）都不能把便當盒放在門邊。

passages.zh: 每天早上，媽媽都會幫我做便當。可是昨天我起晚了，忘了把便當帶出門。中午大家都打開便當，只有我沒東西吃。我的肚子叫得好大聲，同學都笑了。這時我看到爸爸站在教室門口。他手裡拿著我的便當，從他的辦公室一路跑過來。他滿臉通紅，喘個不停。「你看起來很餓喔，」他開玩笑說。我覺得很不好意思，因為他的辦公室離我學校很遠。我跟他道歉，他只是笑笑說：「沒關係，今天晚上記得把便當放在門邊就好。」那天下午，我的飯吃起來比以前都好吃。回家後，我泡了一杯咖啡給爸爸，謝謝他。

passages.title: 雪寶去海邊
passages.text: Olaf the snowman loves summer, but summer doesn't love him. On a hot day, he walked to the beach with Anna. After a few minutes, water began to {1} down his face. "Oh no, I'm melting!" he cried. Anna {2} around for help. Then she saw her sister Elsa coming. Elsa waved her hand, and a small snow cloud appeared over Olaf's head. The cloud followed him everywhere and {3} him from the hot sun. Olaf was so happy that he couldn't {4} dancing on the sand. He even {5} ice cream to the children on the beach. Of course, it didn't melt in his cold hands! At sunset, Olaf said, "This is the best summer day ever." Elsa smiled. "Just don't go too far from your little cloud."

blanks.why: water began to run down「水開始往下流」，run 可以表示液體流動。spell（拼字）、borrow（借）、marry（嫁娶）都不能用 water 當主詞。
look around「四處看」，Anna 四處找人幫忙。spoke、listened、heard 都不能接 around for help 表示「四處尋找」。
protect A from B「保護 A 不受 B 傷害」，雲保護雪寶不被太陽曬。decided、agreed、hoped 都沒有 ___ A from B 的用法。
couldn't stop + V-ing「忍不住一直…」，雪寶開心得一直跳舞。hope、decide、want 後面要接 to V，不能接 dancing。
bring A to B「帶 A 給 B」，雪寶拿冰淇淋給孩子們。spent（花費）、cost（值…錢）、paid（付錢）都不能表示「拿來給」。

gloss: 雪寶（《冰雪奇緣》裡的雪人）
passages.zh: 雪人雪寶很愛夏天，可是夏天不愛他。一個大熱天，他和安娜走到海邊。才過了幾分鐘，水就開始從他臉上流下來。「糟了，我在融化！」他大叫。安娜四處張望，想找人幫忙。這時她看到姊姊艾莎走過來。艾莎揮了揮手，雪寶頭上就出現了一朵小雪雲。這朵雲走到哪就跟到哪，保護他不被大太陽曬到。雪寶開心得在沙灘上跳個不停。他甚至拿冰淇淋給海邊的孩子們吃。當然，冰淇淋在他冰冷的手裡一點也不會融化！日落時，雪寶說：「這是我過過最棒的夏日。」艾莎笑著說：「只是別離你的小雲太遠就好。」

passages.title: 停不下來的打嗝
passages.text: During the math test, Ben started to hiccup. "Hic!" Everyone {1} at him. He tried to {2} it, but it kept coming. He drank some water, held his breath, and even counted to fifty, but nothing worked. The classroom was very {3}, so every "hic" sounded really loud. Ben's face turned red. Then the teacher walked to his desk and said in a serious voice, "Ben, did you {4} my red pen?" Ben was shocked. "No, I didn't!" he said. The teacher smiled. "I know. But listen. Your hiccups are gone!" It was true. The surprise had scared them away. The whole class laughed, and Ben laughed too. After that, he {5} to finish the test without one more "hic."

blanks.why: look at「看著」，大家都看向他。tasted（嚐）、wore（穿戴）、heard（聽到）都不能和 at him 連用表示「看著他」。
stop it「讓它停下來」，想讓打嗝停止。agree（同意）、arrive（抵達）、happen（發生）都是不及物動詞，後面不能接受詞 it。
very quiet「很安靜」，所以每一聲「嗝」都很大聲。crowded（擁擠的）、thirsty（口渴的）、honest（誠實的）都不能說明為什麼聲音聽起來很大。
take my pen「拿走我的筆」，老師故意嚇他。spend（花費）、cost（值…錢）、pay（付錢）都不能接 my red pen。
manage to V「設法做到…」，他終於把考試寫完。enjoy、mind、finish 後面要接 V-ing，不能接 to finish。

passages.zh: 數學考試時，Ben 開始打嗝。「嗝！」大家都看向他。他想讓打嗝停下來，可是它一直來。他喝了水、憋了氣，甚至從一數到五十，但都沒用。教室裡非常安靜，所以每一聲「嗝」聽起來都好大聲。Ben 的臉都紅了。這時老師走到他桌旁，用很嚴肅的聲音說：「Ben，你是不是拿了我的紅筆？」Ben 嚇了一跳。「沒有，我沒拿！」他說。老師笑了：「我知道。可是你聽，你不打嗝了！」真的，這一嚇就把打嗝嚇跑了。全班都笑了，Ben 也笑了。之後，他順利寫完考試，一聲「嗝」都沒再打。

passages.title: 陪阿嬤去診所
passages.text: On Saturday morning, Grandma didn't come down for breakfast. I went upstairs and found her still in bed. "What's the {1}, Grandma?" I asked. "My back hurts," she said. Mom and Dad were at work, so I decided to {2} her to the clinic myself. I called a taxi and helped her walk slowly to the door. At the clinic, the doctor {3} at her back carefully and asked her some questions. "It's nothing serious," he said. "You just need to rest. And you should {4} carrying those heavy rice bags." Grandma smiled like a child who got caught. On the way home, she held my hand. "I'm lucky to have you," she said. That night, I {5} her a cup of hot tea and told her funny stories from school until she fell asleep.

blanks.why: What's the matter?「怎麼了？」。brand（品牌）、talent（才能）、semester（學期）放在這裡都問不出「發生什麼事」。
take A to B「帶 A 去 B」，帶阿嬤去診所。spend（花費）、cost（值…錢）、pay（付錢）都不能表示「帶人去某地」。
look at「看、檢查」，醫生仔細看她的背。heard、said、told 都不能和 at her back 連用。
stop + V-ing「不要再…」，不要再搬重的米袋。hope、plan、agree 後面要接 to V，不能接 carrying。
bring 人 + 物「拿東西給某人」，端一杯熱茶給阿嬤。spent（花費）、cost（值…錢）、paid（付錢）都不能表示「端給她」。

passages.zh: 星期六早上，阿嬤沒有下樓吃早餐。我上樓一看，她還躺在床上。「阿嬤，怎麼了？」我問。「我的背好痛，」她說。爸媽都在上班，所以我決定自己帶她去診所。我叫了一輛計程車，扶著她慢慢走到門口。在診所，醫生仔細看了她的背，問了她一些問題。「不嚴重，」他說，「只要多休息就好。還有，不要再搬那些很重的米袋了。」阿嬤笑得像個被抓到的小孩。回家的路上，她牽著我的手說：「有你真好。」那天晚上，我端了一杯熱茶給她，講學校的好笑故事給她聽，直到她睡著。

passages.title: 排一小時的拉麵
passages.text: There is a famous ramen shop near the train station. People say it's the best in town, so my cousin and I went there on Sunday. The line was very long. It {1} us an hour to get a seat. While we were waiting, a man in front of us kept {2} at his watch. After thirty minutes, he left, saying, "It's not worth it!" When we finally sat down, the cook {3} two big bowls in front of us. The soup was hot, and the noodles were perfect. "Was it worth the wait?" my cousin asked. "It doesn't {4} how long we waited," I said. "This is the best ramen ever!" We finished every drop of the soup. On the way home, I said, "Next week, I'll {5} my parents here. But we'll come at ten, before the line starts!"

blanks.why: It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V「某人做…花了多少時間」。spent 要用人當主詞（We spent an hour…）；paid（付錢）、lent（借出）都不能表示花時間。
keep + V-ing「一直…」，look at his watch「看手錶」。tasting（嚐）、wearing（戴）、hearing（聽）都不能和 at his watch 連用。
put A in front of B「把 A 放在 B 前面」，廚師端上兩碗拉麵。ate（吃）、drank（喝）、wore（穿戴）都不是廚師「端上」碗的動作。
It doesn't matter + 疑問詞子句「…都沒關係」。mind、hope、agree 都不能用 It 當主詞這樣用。
bring 人 + here「帶某人來這裡」。spend（花費）、cost（值…錢）、lend（借出）都不能接 my parents here。

passages.zh: 火車站附近有一家很有名的拉麵店，大家都說那是鎮上最好吃的，所以星期天我和表哥去吃。隊伍好長，我們花了一個小時才有位子。排隊時，我們前面的一個男人一直看手錶。三十分鐘後他離開了，邊走邊說：「不值得！」我們終於坐下時，廚師在我們面前放了兩大碗拉麵。湯很燙，麵條也很完美。「值得等嗎？」表哥問。「等多久都沒關係，」我說，「這是我吃過最好吃的拉麵！」我們把湯喝得一滴不剩。回家路上，我說：「下星期我要帶爸媽來這裡。不過我們十點就來，趁還沒開始排隊！」

passages.title: 第一次自己搭火車
passages.text: Last summer, I {1} the train to Taichung by myself for the first time. My aunt lives there, and I wanted to visit her. Mom was worried. "Remember to {2} at the signs in the station," she said again and again. At Taipei Station, the main hall was so {3} that I almost got on the wrong train. Luckily, a kind lady showed me the right platform. On the train, I sat by the window and watched the rice fields go by. I ate the rice ball Mom made for me and listened to music. About two hours later, the train {4} at Taichung Station. My aunt was waiting for me with a big smile. "You {5} to come all by yourself!" she said. I felt so proud. Now I want to go to Kaohsiung by train next summer.

blanks.why: take the train「搭火車」。grew（長大）、fell（跌落）是不及物動詞，不能接 the train；ate（吃）和火車說不通。
look at「看」，媽媽提醒要看車站的標示。hear、listen、speak 都不能和 at the signs 連用表示「看標示」。
so crowded that…「擠到差點上錯車」。honest（誠實的）、thirsty（口渴的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容車站大廳很多人。
the train stopped at…「火車停在…站」。grew（長大）、wrote（寫）、swam（游泳）都不能用火車當主詞。
manage to V「成功做到…」，自己一個人來了。kept、enjoyed、finished 後面要接 V-ing，不能接 to come。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我第一次自己搭火車去台中。阿姨住在那裡，我想去看她。媽媽很擔心，一再提醒我：「記得看車站裡的標示。」台北車站的大廳擠滿了人，我差點上錯車。幸好一位好心的阿姨告訴我正確的月台。在車上，我坐在窗邊，看著稻田一片片經過。我吃了媽媽幫我做的飯糰，聽著音樂。大約兩個小時後，火車停在台中車站。阿姨笑著在那裡等我。「你自己一個人來了耶！」她說。我覺得好驕傲。現在我想明年夏天搭火車去高雄。

passages.title: 阿嬤頭上的眼鏡
passages.text: "Where are my glasses?" Grandma shouted one morning. She couldn't read the newspaper without them, so everyone started to {1} for them. Dad checked the kitchen, and I checked under the sofa. My little sister even {2} to the garden to look under the flowers. After thirty minutes, we found {3}. Grandma sat down in her chair, looking tired. "It doesn't {4}," she said. "I'll read the news tomorrow." Then my sister laughed and pointed at Grandma's head. The glasses were right there, on top of her white hair! Grandma touched her head and couldn't {5} laughing. "No wonder my head felt so heavy this morning!" she said. Since that day, whenever someone loses something in our house, we always check the top of their head first.

blanks.why: look for「尋找」，大家開始找眼鏡。hear（聽）、taste（嚐）、wear（戴）都沒有 ___ for 表示「尋找」的用法。
ran to the garden「跑到花園」。told、knew、asked 都不是移動的動作，不能接 to the garden。
found nothing「什麼也沒找到」。anything 不能用在肯定句 we found 後面；ever（曾經）、either（也不）都不能當 found 的受詞。
It doesn't matter.「沒關係」，阿嬤說明天再看報紙就好。mind、hope、agree 都不能用 It 當主詞說「沒關係」。
couldn't stop + V-ing「忍不住一直…」，阿嬤笑個不停。hope、plan、agree 後面要接 to V，不能接 laughing。

passages.zh: 「我的眼鏡在哪裡？」一天早上阿嬤大喊。沒有眼鏡她就不能看報紙，所以大家都開始找。爸爸找廚房，我找沙發底下。妹妹甚至跑到花園，去花叢下面找。找了三十分鐘，我們什麼也沒找到。阿嬤坐回她的椅子上，看起來很累。「沒關係，」她說，「明天再看新聞就好。」這時妹妹笑了出來，指著阿嬤的頭。眼鏡就在那裡，在她的白頭髮上！阿嬤摸摸頭，笑個不停。「難怪我今天早上覺得頭好重！」她說。從那天起，我們家只要有人掉了東西，大家都會先看看他的頭頂。

passages.title: 導盲犬 Lucky 上班去
passages.text: Lucky is a guide dog. Every morning, he {1} Mr. Wang, who can't see, to his office. They walk together on the busy streets. When they come to a corner, Lucky always {2} and waits. He {3} left and right before they cross. On the bus, he lies quietly under Mr. Wang's seat. One day, a little boy ran to Lucky and wanted to pet him. Mr. Wang said {4}, "Sorry, he's working now. Please don't touch him." The boy's mom explained to him that Lucky's job is to {5} Mr. Wang from danger, so he must not play during work. But at home, Lucky takes off his harness and becomes a normal dog. He runs around, plays with his ball, and sleeps on the sofa. "He's my eyes," Mr. Wang says, "and my best friend."

blanks.why: take A to B「帶 A 去 B」，Lucky 帶王先生去辦公室。spends（花費）、costs（值…錢）、pays（付錢）都不能表示「帶人去某地」。
stops and waits「停下來等」，到了路口要停。spells（拼字）、borrows（借）、marries（嫁娶）放在這裡都說不通。
look left and right「左右看」，過馬路前先看兩邊。tastes（嚐）、wears（穿戴）、tells（告訴）都不能接 left and right 表示「往左右看」。
said politely「有禮貌地說」，王先生客氣地請小孩別摸。cheaply（便宜地）、heavily（沉重地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容說話的態度。
protect A from B「保護 A 不受 B 傷害」。decide、agree、hope 都沒有 ___ A from B 的用法。

passages.zh: Lucky 是一隻導盲犬。每天早上，牠帶看不見的王先生去辦公室。他們一起走在熱鬧的街上。到了路口，Lucky 一定會停下來等，過馬路前先左右看。在公車上，牠安靜地趴在王先生的座位下。有一天，一個小男孩跑向 Lucky，想摸摸牠。王先生有禮貌地說：「不好意思，牠正在工作，請不要摸牠。」男孩的媽媽跟他解釋，Lucky 的工作是保護王先生不遇到危險，所以工作時不能玩。不過一回到家，Lucky 脫下導盲鞍，就變成一隻普通的狗。牠到處跑、玩球，還睡在沙發上。「牠是我的眼睛，」王先生說，「也是我最好的朋友。」

passages.title: 功夫熊貓守護餃子
passages.text: Po the panda is a kung fu master, but he is also a big eater. One night, he made two hundred dumplings for a party in the village. Before the guests came, a group of wolves {1} into the kitchen. They wanted to {2} all the dumplings away. "Stop!" Po shouted. He jumped in front of the table to {3} the food. The wolves {4} at him and laughed. "You're too fat to fight!" But Po moved fast. He kicked, he jumped, and he even used a pot as a shield. In five minutes, the wolves were all on the floor. "Sorry," they said. "We were just hungry." Po thought for a moment. Then he smiled and gave each of them a dumpling. "Next time, just ask," he said. Later that night, the wolves {5} to the party as guests, and they helped Po wash all the dishes.

blanks.why: ran into the kitchen「跑進廚房」。said、knew、thought 都不是移動的動作，不能接 into the kitchen。
take A away「把 A 拿走」，狼想把餃子全拿走。spend（花費）、cost（值…錢）、pay（付錢）都沒有 ___ A away 表示「拿走」的用法。
protect the food「保護食物」，阿波跳到桌子前面擋住。decide（決定）、agree（同意）、hope（希望）都不能接 the food 表示「守護」。
look at「看著」，狼看著他大笑。heard、spoke、told 都不能和 at him 連用表示「看著他」。
return to + 地方「回到…」，狼後來以客人的身分回到派對。spent、cost、lent 都不能接 to the party 表示「回來」。

passages.zh: 熊貓阿波是功夫大師，也是個大胃王。一天晚上，他為村裡的派對包了兩百顆餃子。客人還沒來，一群狼就衝進了廚房，想把餃子全部拿走。「住手！」阿波大喊。他跳到桌子前面保護食物。狼看著他大笑：「你太胖了，根本打不了！」可是阿波動作很快。他又踢又跳，甚至拿鍋子當盾牌。五分鐘後，狼全倒在地上。「對不起，」牠們說，「我們只是肚子餓。」阿波想了一下，然後笑著給每隻狼一顆餃子。「下次直接說就好，」他說。那天晚上，狼群以客人的身分回到派對，還幫阿波把碗盤全洗乾淨。

passages.title: 當班長的難題
passages.text: This semester, I became the class leader. At first, I thought it would be easy, but it wasn't. Every morning before class, I tried to make everyone {1} talking, but nobody listened to me. Some boys even kept {2} around the classroom. I felt like giving up. Then our teacher told me, "You don't have to do everything alone. Give people jobs." So I asked Kevin, the noisiest boy in our class, to {3} after the plants by the window. He was surprised, but he took the job seriously. He watered them every day and even stopped making so much noise. Soon, other students wanted jobs too. A month later, the classroom was {4} every morning before class. I learned that being a leader isn't about giving orders. It's about {5} people together.

blanks.why: make + 人 + 原形動詞，stop + V-ing「停止…」，讓大家不要再講話。hope、plan、agree 後面要接 to V，不能接 talking。
keep + V-ing「一直…」，一直在教室裡跑來跑去。spelling（拼字）、borrowing（借）、marrying（嫁娶）都不能接 around the classroom。
look after「照顧」，請 Kevin 照顧窗邊的植物。hear、listen、speak 都沒有 ___ after 表示「照顧」的用法。
quiet「安靜的」，上課前教室變安靜了。thirsty（口渴的）、honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容教室。
bring people together「讓大家團結在一起」，about 後面接 V-ing。spending、costing、paying 都不能接 people together。

passages.zh: 這學期我當上了班長。一開始我以為很簡單，但其實不然。每天早上上課前，我都想讓大家安靜下來，可是沒有人聽我的，有些男生甚至一直在教室裡跑來跑去。我真想放棄。後來老師對我說：「你不用什麼事都自己做，分配工作給大家吧。」所以我請班上最吵的男生 Kevin 照顧窗邊的植物。他很驚訝，但很認真地做這份工作。他每天澆水，甚至不再那麼吵了。不久，其他同學也想要工作。一個月後，每天早上上課前教室都很安靜。我學到了，當班長不是在發號施令，而是讓大家團結在一起。

passages.title: 逾期兩週的圖書
passages.text: Last month, I borrowed three books from the city library. They were about space, and I loved them so much that I forgot to {1} them on time. When I {2} took them back, they were two weeks late. The librarian {3} at her computer and said, "That's sixty dollars, please." Sixty dollars! I only had forty dollars in my pocket. My face turned red. "I'm sorry. Can I pay the rest tomorrow?" I asked. The librarian smiled. "Sure. And next time, {4} a sticker on your desk to remind yourself." The next day, I paid the rest of the money with my own pocket money. It was a good lesson. Now I always {5} my books back a day early, and I never have to pay again.

blanks.why: return them「歸還它們」，忘了準時還書。appear（出現）、smile（微笑）、happen（發生）都是不及物動詞，後面不能接受詞 them。
finally「終於」，拖了兩週終於拿去還。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、loudly（大聲地）都不能表示拖了很久之後才做。
look at「看著」，館員看著電腦。smelled（聞）、wore（穿戴）、heard（聽到）都不能和 at her computer 連用表示「看著」。
put A on B「把 A 貼在 B 上」，在書桌上貼一張貼紙。eat（吃）、drink（喝）、spell（拼字）都不能接 a sticker on your desk。
bring A back「把 A 帶回來（歸還）」。spend（花費）、cost（值…錢）、lend（借出）都沒有 ___ A back 表示「還回去」的用法。

passages.zh: 上個月，我從市立圖書館借了三本書。那些書在講太空，我太喜歡了，結果忘了準時還。我終於拿去還的時候，已經晚了兩個星期。館員看著電腦說：「一共六十元。」六十元！我口袋裡只有四十元，臉都紅了。「對不起，剩下的可以明天再付嗎？」我問。館員笑著說：「當然可以。下次在書桌上貼一張貼紙提醒自己吧。」隔天，我用自己的零用錢付清了剩下的錢。這是很好的一課。現在我都會提早一天把書還回去，再也不用付錢了。

passages.title: 颱風來之前
passages.text: The news said a strong typhoon was coming, so Dad asked me to help him get our balcony ready. First, we {1} all the flower pots inside. Then we {2} tape on the big windows. Mom went to the supermarket to buy food and water. It was so crowded that she waited in line for forty minutes. That night, the wind was very strong. Trees were shaking outside, and the rain {3} down the windows like a river. We heard a loud sound and {4} outside. A trash can was flying down the street! In the morning, the rain stopped. We saw that a big tree in the park had fallen. But all our plants were safe in the living room. "Good thing we {5} our plants," Dad said. My little sister hugged her small cactus and said, "Thank you for saving him."

blanks.why: bring A inside「把 A 搬進屋裡」。spent（花費）、cost（值…錢）、paid（付錢）都不能接 the flower pots inside。
put A on B「把 A 貼在 B 上」，在窗戶貼膠帶。ate（吃）、drank（喝）、wore（穿戴）都不能接 tape on the windows。
the rain ran down「雨水往下流」，run 可表示液體流動。grew（長大）、wrote（寫）、swam（游泳）都不能用雨水當主詞說「流下」。
look outside「往外看」，聽到聲音往外看。smelled（聞）、wore（穿戴）、heard（聽到）放在 We heard a loud sound and ___ outside 裡都說不通。
protected our plants「保護了我們的植物」，颱風前搬進屋內。decided（決定）、agreed（同意）、hoped（希望）都不能接 our plants 當受詞。

passages.zh: 新聞說有強烈颱風要來，所以爸爸叫我幫他整理陽台。首先，我們把所有花盆搬進屋裡，接著在大窗戶上貼了膠帶。媽媽去超市買食物和水，人多到她排了四十分鐘的隊。那天晚上風好大，外面的樹搖來搖去，雨水像河一樣沿著窗戶流下來。我們聽到一聲巨響，往外一看，一個垃圾桶在街上飛！早上雨停了。我們看到公園裡有一棵大樹倒了，但我們的植物都安全地待在客廳裡。「還好我們有保護植物，」爸爸說。妹妹抱著她的小仙人掌說：「謝謝你們救了它。」

passages.title: 公園長椅上的手機
passages.text: On my way home from school, I saw a phone on a bench in the park. Nobody was around. I {1} around, but I couldn't find its owner. Just then, the phone rang. I answered it. A woman said, "Hello? That's my phone! I left it in the park an hour ago." She sounded very worried. "Please {2} worrying," I said. "I'll wait here for you." Twenty minutes later, a woman with a baby {3} into the park. "Thank you so much!" she said. "All my baby's photos are in this phone." She tried to give me five hundred dollars, but I said, "It doesn't {4}. I'm just happy to {5} it to you." She thanked me again and again. When I got home, I told Mom the story. She gave me a big hug and said, "I'm proud of you."

blanks.why: look around「四處看」。smelled（聞）、wrote（寫）、told（告訴）都不能接 around 表示「四處張望」。
stop + V-ing「不要再…」，請她別擔心。hope、plan、agree 後面要接 to V，不能接 worrying。
ran into the park「跑進公園」，她急著來拿手機。told、learned、guessed 都不是移動的動作，不能接 into the park。
It doesn't matter.「沒關係、不用了」，婉拒她的錢。mind、hope、agree 都不能用 It 當主詞說「沒關係」。
return A to B「把 A 還給 B」。appear（出現）、smile（微笑）、happen（發生）都是不及物動詞，不能接受詞 it。

passages.zh: 放學回家的路上，我看到公園長椅上有一支手機，四周都沒有人。我四處看了看，找不到它的主人。就在這時，手機響了，我接起來。一位女士說：「喂？那是我的手機！我一個小時前把它忘在公園了。」她聽起來很著急。「請別擔心，」我說，「我在這裡等您。」二十分鐘後，一位抱著寶寶的女士跑進公園。「真的太謝謝你了！」她說，「我寶寶所有的照片都在這支手機裡。」她想給我五百元，但我說：「不用了，能把手機還給您我就很開心了。」她一直向我道謝。回家後，我把這件事告訴媽媽，她給了我一個大大的擁抱，說：「我以你為榮。」

passages.title: 開學第一天走錯教室
passages.text: It was my first day of junior high school. The school was big, and I got lost. When the bell rang, I {1} into the nearest classroom and sat down. The students all {2} at me strangely. Then a tall teacher walked in and said, "Good morning, ninth graders!" Ninth graders? I was in seventh grade! My face turned red. I wanted to say something, but I was too nervous, so I said {3}. When the teacher started the roll call, she didn't find my name on her list. She {4} and asked, "Who are you?" Everyone laughed, and I wanted to hide under the desk. But the teacher was kind. She {5} me to my real classroom herself. Now I'm in ninth grade, and every year, I tell this story to the new students on their first day.

blanks.why: ran into the classroom「跑進教室」，鐘響了趕快進去。told、knew、guessed 都不是移動的動作，不能接 into the nearest classroom。
look at「看著」，大家用奇怪的眼神看我。smelled（聞）、wrote（寫）、heard（聽到）都不能和 at me strangely 連用。
said nothing「什麼也沒說」。anything 不能用在肯定句 I said 後面；ever（曾經）、either（也不）都不能當 said 的受詞。
stopped and asked「停下來問」，老師點名找不到我的名字。spelled（拼字）、borrowed（借）、married（嫁娶）放在這裡都說不通。
take 人 to + 地方「帶某人去…」。spent（花費）、paid（付錢）、lent（借出）都不能表示「帶我去教室」。

passages.zh: 那是我國中開學的第一天。學校好大，我迷路了。鐘一響，我就跑進最近的一間教室坐下。全班同學都用奇怪的眼神看著我。接著一位高高的老師走進來說：「九年級的同學早安！」九年級？我是七年級耶！我的臉都紅了。我想說點什麼，可是太緊張了，所以什麼也沒說。老師開始點名，在名單上找不到我的名字。她停下來問：「你是誰？」大家都笑了，我好想躲到桌子底下。不過老師很親切，她親自帶我去我真正的教室。現在我已經九年級了，每年開學第一天，我都會把這個故事講給新生聽。

passages.title: 爸爸的早餐店
passages.text: My dad {1} a small breakfast shop near our school. He gets up at four every morning to make sandwiches and egg pancakes. On weekends, I help him. My job is to {2} orders from the customers. At seven, the shop is so {3} that I have no time to sit down. One Saturday, a little boy came in alone. He {4} sad and stood at the door for a long time. "What's the {5}?" I asked. He said he had lost his money on the way. Dad heard this and gave him a free egg pancake. "You can pay me next time," he said. The next day, the boy came back with forty dollars and a drawing of Dad in his apron. Dad put the drawing on the wall, and it's still there today. Dad says it's the best thing in his shop.

blanks.why: run a shop「經營一家店」，run 在這裡是「經營」。tells（告訴）、knows（知道）、guesses（猜）都不能表示「開店、經營」。
take orders「點餐、接受點單」。spend（花費）、cost（值…錢）、lend（借出）都不能接 orders from the customers。
so crowded that…「擠到沒時間坐」。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能形容店裡人很多。
look + 形容詞「看起來…」，他看起來很難過。smelled（聞起來）不能形容心情；wrote、told 後面都不能直接接形容詞 sad。
What's the matter?「怎麼了？」。brand（品牌）、talent（才能）、semester（學期）都問不出「發生什麼事」。

passages.zh: 我爸爸在我們學校附近開了一家小早餐店。他每天早上四點起床做三明治和蛋餅。週末我會去幫忙，我的工作是幫客人點餐。七點的時候，店裡擠到我連坐下的時間都沒有。有一個星期六，一個小男孩自己走進來。他看起來很難過，在門口站了很久。「怎麼了？」我問。他說他的錢在路上弄丟了。爸爸聽到了，就送他一份蛋餅。「下次再付就好，」他說。隔天，男孩帶著四十元回來，還有一張畫，畫的是穿著圍裙的爸爸。爸爸把那張畫貼在牆上，到今天都還在。爸爸說那是他店裡最棒的東西。

passages.title: 把垃圾帶下山
passages.text: Last weekend, our class went hiking on Yangmingshan. Before we started, our teacher said, "Remember, whatever you {1} up the mountain, you must carry down." The road was steep, and it {2} us three hours to reach the top. The view was beautiful, but we were surprised to see plastic bottles and snack bags on the ground. "Let's {3} them in our bags," said Amy. Everyone agreed. We spent thirty minutes picking up trash. On the way down, a man {4} us and asked, "Why are you carrying so much trash?" "We want to {5} the mountain," we answered. He smiled and gave us a thumbs-up. Then he took a bag out of his backpack and started picking up trash too. Our teacher said that was the best lesson of the whole trip.

blanks.why: bring A up the mountain「把 A 帶上山」。spend（花費）、cost（值…錢）、lend（借出）都不能接 up the mountain 表示「帶上山」。
It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V「某人做…花了多少時間」。spent 要用人當主詞（We spent three hours…）；paid、lent 都不能表示花時間。
put A in B「把 A 放進 B」，把垃圾放進背包。eat（吃）、drink（喝）、spell（拼字）都不能接 them in our bags。
stop + 人「叫住某人、攔住某人」。spelled（拼字）、wrote（寫）、guessed（猜）都不能接 us 表示「叫住我們」。
protect the mountain「保護山林」。decide（決定）、agree（同意）、hope（希望）都不能接 the mountain 當受詞。

passages.zh: 上週末，我們班去爬陽明山。出發前，老師說：「記住，帶什麼上山，就要帶什麼下山。」山路很陡，我們花了三個小時才爬到山頂。風景很美，但我們很驚訝地看到地上有寶特瓶和零食袋。「我們把它們放進背包吧，」Amy 說。大家都同意了，我們花了三十分鐘撿垃圾。下山時，一位先生叫住我們問：「你們為什麼背這麼多垃圾？」「我們想保護這座山，」我們回答。他笑著對我們比讚，接著從背包裡拿出一個袋子，也開始撿垃圾。老師說那是這趟旅行最棒的一課。

passages.title: 球場上扭傷之後
passages.text: Jason loves basketball more than anything. In a game last month, he jumped for the ball and landed on someone's foot. He fell down and couldn't stand up. His teammates {1} over to help him. The doctor said his ankle was badly hurt, and he had to {2} playing for six weeks. Jason was very sad, but he didn't just stay at home. He went to every practice and sat on the bench. He {3} carefully at how the other players moved and took notes in a small book. He learned a lot about the game this way. Six weeks later, he {4} to the team. To everyone's surprise, he played better than before. Now he always wears a brace to {5} his ankle. "Getting hurt taught me to use my eyes and my head, not just my legs," he says.

blanks.why: ran over「跑過來」，隊友跑過去幫他。told、knew、guessed 都不是移動的動作，不能接 over to help him。
stop + V-ing「停止…」，六週不能打球。hope、plan、agree 後面要接 to V，不能接 playing。
look at「看著、觀察」，仔細看其他球員怎麼移動。smelled（聞）、wore（穿戴）、heard（聽到）都不能和 at how… 連用表示「觀察」。
return to + 地方／團體「回到…」，他歸隊了。spelled（拼字）、borrowed（借）、guessed（猜）都不能接 to the team 表示「回到」。
protect his ankle「保護他的腳踝」。decide（決定）、agree（同意）、hope（希望）都不能接 his ankle 當受詞。

passages.zh: Jason 最愛打籃球了。上個月的一場比賽中，他跳起來搶球，落地時踩到別人的腳。他跌倒了，站不起來，隊友們都跑過去幫他。醫生說他的腳踝傷得很重，六個星期不能打球。Jason 很難過，但他沒有只待在家裡。他每次練球都到場，坐在板凳上。他仔細觀察其他球員怎麼移動，把筆記寫在一本小本子裡。他就這樣學到了很多關於籃球的事。六個星期後，他歸隊了。讓大家驚訝的是，他打得比以前更好。現在他總是戴著護具保護腳踝。「受傷讓我學會用眼睛和頭腦打球，而不只是用腿，」他說。
